healthy_rice.immediate_steps: Monitor the plant regularly and keep leaves dry where possible.
healthy_rice.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep balanced watering and feeding, and remove any dead leaves promptly.
healthy_rice.prevention: Give good air circulation, avoid overwatering, and check leaves weekly so any new problem is caught early.
healthy_rice.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

rice_bacterial_blight.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves carefully, do not compost them, and clean tools after handling the plant. Avoid working with wet plants.
rice_bacterial_blight.treatment: A copper-based bactericide (copper oxychloride) labelled for rice bacterial blight may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice. Antibiotics such as streptocycline are used where registered.
rice_bacterial_blight.prevention: Use disease-free seed and resistant varieties where available, avoid excess nitrogen, improve drainage, and rotate crops.
rice_bacterial_blight.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

rice_blast.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and avoid wetting leaves when watering.
rice_blast.treatment: A fungicide labelled for rice blast, such as tricyclazole or propiconazole, may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice.
rice_blast.prevention: Use resistant varieties and certified seed, avoid excess nitrogen applied at once, water at the base, and clean up infected straw.
rice_blast.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

rice_brown_spot.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and avoid wetting leaves when watering.
rice_brown_spot.treatment: A fungicide labelled for rice brown spot, such as propiconazole or azoxystrobin, may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice. Seed treatment helps against seed-borne infection.
rice_brown_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seed, keep plants well fed (balanced potash), improve drainage, and rotate crops.
rice_brown_spot.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

rice_leaf_scald.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and avoid wetting leaves when watering.
rice_leaf_scald.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.
rice_leaf_scald.prevention: Use resistant varieties and certified seed, avoid excess nitrogen, and clean up infected straw.
rice_leaf_scald.treatment: A fungicide labelled for rice leaf scald, such as propiconazole or copper oxychloride, may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice.

rice_sheath_blight.immediate_steps: Drain excess water, widen spacing for airflow, and remove infected straw.
rice_sheath_blight.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.
rice_sheath_blight.prevention: Space plants for airflow, apply nitrogen in split doses, drain excess water, and rotate crops.
rice_sheath_blight.treatment: A fungicide labelled for rice sheath blight, such as validamycin or hexaconazole, may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice.

rice_tungro.immediate_steps: Remove severely infected plants so the virus does not spread, and control the green leafhoppers that carry it.
rice_tungro.treatment: There is no chemical cure for tungro virus. Focus on controlling the leafhopper vector and removing infected material.
rice_tungro.prevention: Use resistant varieties where available, plant at the same time as neighbouring fields, control leafhoppers, and keep bunds free of weeds that host the virus.
rice_tungro.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.
